title: Freebies Directory for Healthcare Workers
note: Official links only. Education and support resources; never medical advice.

resources.title: CDC TRAIN / CDC Learning Lab
resources.description: Free continuing education courses for healthcare professionals from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Topics include infection control, emergency preparedness, and public health practice.

resources.title: OpenWHO
resources.description: Free online courses from the World Health Organization for health workers and responders, including outbreak response, infection prevention, and clinical care.

resources.title: American Nurses Association (ANA) Free CE
resources.description: Free continuing education webinars and courses for nurses. Some offerings are ANA-member benefits; others are open to all nurses.

resources.title: HRSA Nurse Corps Scholarship Program
resources.description: Scholarships for nursing students in exchange for service at a critical shortage facility, plus loan repayment for eligible nurses.

resources.title: ANA Foundation Scholarships and Grants
resources.description: Scholarships, research grants, and awards for nurses advancing their education or practice through the American Nurses Foundation.

resources.title: CDC Printable Resources
resources.description: Free printable fact sheets, posters, and handouts for healthcare settings, covering infection control, immunizations, and workplace health.

resources.title: MedlinePlus Printable Handouts
resources.description: Free printable health handouts and easy-to-read materials from the National Library of Medicine for patient education and staff reference.

resources.title: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
resources.description: Free, confidential 24/7 support for anyone in emotional distress or crisis, including healthcare workers. Call or text 988.

resources.title: SAMHSA National Helpline
resources.description: Free, confidential 24/7 treatment referral and information line for mental health and substance use concerns. Call 1-800-662-HELP (4357).

resources.title: Emotional PPE Project
resources.description: Connects healthcare workers with free, confidential mental health support from licensed providers. No insurance required.

resources.title: NIOSH Safety and Health Topics
resources.description: Free workplace safety and health resources for healthcare workers from the National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health, including safe patient handling and stress prevention.
